'''Gary Lee''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[October 2001 Vancouver tournament]] on 6 October 2001 with [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|SYC non-flip Big Blue]], according to Matt Lush's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3042">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-10-mr-lush-goes-to-vancouverd3042/ mr-lush-goes-to-vancouver], DeckTech (Matt "Old Skooler" Lush, 10 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-10-mr-lush-goes-to-vancouverd3042/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
